summary: Completed comprehensive testing of customer accounts system for Just Ayurveda e-commerce. Phone OTP flow partially working (send OTP works, verification fails), Email authentication working, navbar and navigation functioning correctly. Critical issue found with customer token authentication preventing account dashboard access.

critical_bugs.impact: Account dashboard, profile, addresses, orders, wishlist completely non-functional

This breaks the entire customer account system including OTP login, profile management, addresses, orders, and wishlist functionality.
